mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course WHERE course_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CAST(course_code AS VARCHAR) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

SELECT c.course_code, c.course_name, c.teacher, c.credits, c.hours, c.cover_url, c.description, c.applicable_major, c.course_objectives, COALESCE(l.lesson_count, 0) AS lesson_count FROM course c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_code, COUNT(*) AS lesson_count FROM lesson GROUP BY course_code ) l ON l.course_code = c.course_code ORDER BY c.course_code

SELECT c.course_code, c.course_name, c.teacher, c.credits, c.hours, c.cover_url, c.description, c.applicable_major, c.course_objectives, COALESCE(l.lesson_count, 0) AS lesson_count FROM course c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_code, COUNT(*) AS lesson_count FROM lesson GROUP BY course_code ) l ON l.course_code = c.course_code WHERE c.course_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CAST(c.course_code AS VARCHAR) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY c.course_code
